args.name: Small-sample food preparation and measured air drying
args.function: Enable a physically grounded experiment exposing the interior of a small owned root sample and measuring actual moisture change against an equal untreated reference. Identify feasible preparation, support and measurement methods; do not grant preservation automatically.
args.conditions: At tick 14 I own 6.9 roots, health is 100, satiety 81.4 and energy 39.3. Root nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 are personally known. A press trial consumed 0.1 root and recorded flexibility 0 at load 0.25. Heating failed for lack of a nearby heat source. I have no confirmed suitable tool or clean support. Current weather is mild with no rain.
args.inputs: Small owned root sample and equal untreated reference. Any needed tool, clean support or measuring equipment must actually be identified and acquired. Preparation method and required materials remain unknown.
args.costs: Unknown. Require actual learning time, effort, elapsed drying time and material expenditure as appropriate. Preserve enough roots for meals; do not reserve my entire food supply.
args.effects: Permit preparation and observation of physically represented moisture change and sample condition under actual weather. Failure is possible. No automatic safety, preservation, nutritional improvement or reward; conclusions require real trials.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

candidates.function: Lay a small open fuel bed of your own fuel, light it by hand friction or from a hot bed, feed, inspect or smother it; it burns on its own until fuel or air runs out.
candidates.costs: Study 4 rounds. Beds are in reach within 0.65 m. tend, 1 round, 0.5 energy: with x,y lays a new 0.2 m bed (firm open ground, footprint clear, nobody on it), else feeds your own bed; takes quantity (default 1) from each own fuelItemIds item (inedible with fuel value) and tinderItemIds item (dry grass, bark, moss, reed); holds 1.6 kg. inspect: anyone, 1 round, 0.2 energy via probe observe. attempt-ignition on your unlit bed with 0.5 tinder and 0.5 fuel, inspected by you within 10 rounds, while you hold sand or clay totaling 2.01 kg named in extinguishingItemIds: friction, toolItemIds rubbing then base piece, whole rigid wood units at least 0.3 m long, rubbing 1.5-5 cm thick and not softer, base 3 cm+, durationRounds 1-5 (default 3) at 1 energy per worked round; hot-target, 1 round, 0.5 energy, from the bed at 300 C+ or a brand from your burning bed within 1 m. extinguish: anyone, 1 round, 0.5 energy plus 2.01 kg of your listed sand or clay (or quantity from each). Failed checks spend nothing.
candidates.effects: Water share is the represented one (branch 0.5, dry grass 0.4); only burning fuel dries. Friction: 1 energy = 21.6 kJ; contact reaches air+15(n-1)+contact*dryness*500/(1+0.5wind) C, dryness 1-water/0.35, contact rising as the groove wears; 350 C with 2 g dust forms an ember, which lights tinder of water <=0.35 at rain <=0.15 and wind <=0.65; wear 2 g a round. Fire: up to 1 fuel unit (2 MJ) a round times (1-water), 10% ash, embers 3 rounds, rain >0.6 douses, rain wets fuel +0.08*rain; burning fuel dries 0.08 a round; leaving or death never stops it. A fifth of the heat holds the bed, a tenth reaches people: within 2 m +0.6*burn*(1-d/2)*(1-0.5wind) degrees; on the bed -5*burn health; loose fuel and combustible stock within 0.45 m catch; probes in reach draw stored heat. Smothering closes air; the bed cools; inspect reads it. No cooking, safety or reward.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"moss\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general prepared-sample air-drying experiment, not a root-specific interface. Related-capability searches and the supplied exact probe definition have been reviewed. air-dry-food-trial is a useful implementation dependency but is not equivalent: it accepts whole units, expressly prevents their evaporation, and does not measure water. probe supports observation, press, wet and heat, not cutting or gravimetry. Neither the failed press nor the unavailable heat source establishes a usable preparation method. No further searches are available; reconcile the remaining registry in the current-conversation handoff before coding, reusing any equivalent implementation found there. Missing preparation, measurement or moisture-transfer mechanisms require development, not permanent rejection or invented equipment.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: prepare and compare material samples. Parameters: mode=start|prepare|measure|tend|stop, sourceItemId, sampleQuantity, preparation=split|slice, toolId, supportId, measurementDeviceId, location, durationRounds and trialId as applicable. Initial executable scope is mechanical exposure of an owned food sample, a matched untreated reference, and physically measured mass change during ambient exposure. Other materials are admitted only when their mechanical and water-state definitions support the same operation. No heating, preservation certification or automatic fabrication is included.\\nReferences and reuse: use air-dry-food-trial's trial lifecycle, ownership/reservation, support checks, weather scheduling, provenance, decay and ending logic; record actual reused code and revisions. Do not change its established whole-unit behavior. Use probe/open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, for ordinary visible inspection, and existing navigate, gather, pickup and drop for their actual actions. New code supplies preparation, fractional sample handling, physical gravimetry and exposed-surface moisture transfer. Implementation must resolve exact internal handler references from the registry rather than inventing them.\\nPrerequisites: individual completion of study; actor alive and capable, all active targets within ordinary interaction reach, an owned usable unspoiled source, sufficient energy, suitable acquired cutting/splitting implement, validated support and a real calibrated measuring device. Tools must have represented geometry, edge/strength and cleanliness sufficient for the chosen material; a name or visible stone is not proof. The observed start-2-stone is only an observed source, not an owned tool or clean surface. No support, instrument, fuel, water or tool is granted. A balance must have physically represented pans/support, a functioning comparison mechanism and acquired calibrated reference masses or another independently validated calibration; arbitrary item counts and inventory quantities are not measurements. Implement this general measurement mechanism in the same handoff if absent; its materials, construction actions and calibration must be paid for before use, not silently supplied. Unknown or unsuitable equipment blocks that mode with an explicit missing prerequisite. No compulsory tool-making roadmap or era restriction.\\nStart costs and allocation: default sampleQuantity=0.1 material unit and referenceQuantity=0.1 from the same owned stack; source quantum must permit both. Require an explicit affirmative quantity argument before allocating more than this default; never reserve the full food supply. For the supplied item-2-moss-11, the default would allocate 0.2 of 6.9 roots and leave 6.7 unreserved if its current state still permits the action. Validate current state rather than the applicant's older vitals. Start costs one world round and 0.2 energy, then separates and reserves the two samples with inherited origin, harvest time, decay, dry matter, water, nutrient and toxin amounts. Allocation creates no mass and is not destruction. Small aliquots must retain the parent's actual whole-food geometry until preparation; stack subdivision must not itself expose an interior or create an evaporation advantage. If physical aliquoting requires a cut, charge and perform it explicitly for both samples and record that the reference is minimally cut, not literally untouched. Prefer matched existing whole pieces where the material permits them.\\nPreparation: one round and 0.5 energy per attempted split or slice, with tool wear and any lost fragments recorded. Resolve force, edge and fracture resistance from represented material/tool properties. Success creates actual exposed surfaces and separate pieces; failure may leave unchanged or damaged material and must report the actual outcome. Do not infer success from the earlier flexibility=0 result. Validate support as in air-dry-food-trial: owned/available, clean, dry, rigid, non-toxic, non-perishable, sufficiently large and on firm clear ground. Fractional samples require enough actual area for their geometry, never less than the inherited 0.04 square metres per material unit. Food contact changes contamination only through represented contact rules; unassessed cleanliness is not verified safety. The reference remains carried/reserved under the existing trial conditions, with its actual decay and moisture dynamics, not an asserted constant baseline.\\nMeasurement: each actual before/after weighing costs one round and 0.2 energy per sample; instrument setup, travel, calibration and movement cost separately. Record calibration event, resolution, uncertainty, tare, timestamp, trial/sample IDs and physical reading. Unknown baseline mass cannot be backfilled from inventory metadata. Net mass loss is not automatically measured moisture loss: report it as mass change unless water transfer is the only established mass-changing process or other changes have independently measured bounds. Reference-adjusted change must include uncertainty from all readings. No absolute moisture fraction is disclosed by ordinary inspection or weighing. A loss below resolution is unresolved, not zero. Missing equipment still permits a visibly observed preparation trial, but not a claimed quantitative drying result.\\nOngoing drying: durationRounds defaults to 10 and is an observation window, not a success timer. Only genuinely exposed surfaces receive the new moisture-transfer process; unchanged whole food retains the existing no-evaporation rule. Each simulation step conserves dry matter and solutes, transfers evaporated water to the environmental water ledger and debits latent heat from actual environmental/sample heat exchange. Implement explicit surface area, liquid-water accessibility, temperature, atmospheric humidity, airflow and rain coupling. Water loss is bounded by accessible water, transfer capacity and available heat divided by water's latent heat; temperature and water reservoirs update consistently. No drying occurs merely because a timer or label says dry. Weather missing necessary state requires an explicit environmental implementation/default policy in the handoff, not actor-visible fabricated readings. Cold, humid, sheltered or rainy conditions can give negligible loss or net gain. Rain water, runoff, drips, crumbs, tool residue, spoilage losses and contamination changes must have recorded destinations and sources. Implement a conservative bounded transfer model with declared coefficients, units, timestep and tests before enabling this mode; do not enable a decorative process with unimplemented physics. Mild weather and no rain alone do not prove a drying rate.\\nConservation and products: track water and dry matter separately in material mass units, mapping material units to actual mass through the material definition, never assuming one root unit is one kilogram. Preparation partitions existing nutrition and toxins; evaporation removes water, not nutrients or toxins, and cannot increase total edible nutrition. No resets of decay, freshness or harvest time. Real products are the remaining prepared pieces, reference, recoverable offcuts/residue and evidence records; water may enter air or runoff. Unmeasured contamination, chemical change and safety remain unknown. No automatic preservation, increased nutrition, safety, healing, heat or pleasure is awarded.\\nProgress and lifecycle: log each completed allocation, cut, placement, weighing and observation once with input/output references. Invalid prechecks spend nothing. A committed action spends its actual round, energy, wear and materials even if informative failure follows. Interrupted uncommitted actions release only unspent reservations; committed cuts, exposures and readings persist. Resume revalidates access, instrument calibration and current material state without repeating completed charges. Tend costs one round and 0.2 energy, as in air-dry-food-trial, and physically turns or relocates accessible samples without invented water loss. Maintenance consists of actual access, support cleanliness/stability, calibration, recovery and weather protection; each requires its own physical inputs/actions. Passive exposure and ordinary decay continue during absence, interruption and death while the world advances. Review/development waiting advances no world time. Stop costs one round and zero energy, releases the reference exactly once and leaves exposed pieces/support for real pickup. Expiry, spoilage or loss of all treated material ends the comparison under the existing lifecycle. Death releases actor reservations without retrieving or refunding physical goods, and ends actor-directed work, not environmental processes. Cancellation never restores spent energy, destroyed material, tool wear, time or evaporated water; only unused reserved goods are released. Actual others may act on accessible objects under normal rules, with their own independent actions; no consent, communication or participation is presumed.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"No experience reward for requesting, registration, study, equipment naming, waiting for review or successful-looking animation. Verified new information from a completed measurement or informative preparation failure may qualify when personally applicable and supported by an actual event. Apply established experience rules in code, deduplicating by material, method, conditions and informational result rather than ability name. If no compatible reward handler exists, issue evidence only until the handoff implements a bounded handler: at most one short pleasure increment of 0.01 per actor per 10-round window for a qualifying observation, capped at 0.05 outstanding and decaying by 0.01 per round; modest maintained satisfaction may accrue at no more than the supplied mentalRate 0.04 per qualifying round, capped at 1 and decaying at mentalDecay 0.002 per round. Familiar legitimate experimental practice can qualify without forced novelty, but repeated commands, duplicated readings and unattended elapsed time cannot. These are ordinary experience signals only: do not alter protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. Physical comfort from this operation defaults to zero and any separately established comfort remains capped at 10. Basic nutrition and hunger are not reduced by mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit reusable events for allocation, preparation attempt, fracture/cut, placement, physical weighing, reading, tending, water transfer, rain uptake, interruption and ending. Include actor when applicable, trial/sample/tool/support/instrument IDs, location, time, quantities, geometric surface changes, stage, outcome, uncertainty, evidence references and revision. Render visible cuts, actual pieces, support occupancy, instrument motion and observable wetness/shrinkage only when physically represented and perceptible. Keep underlying moisture and environmental state out of actor-visible metadata unless legitimately measured; distinguish instrument readings from internal simulation events. Use reusable material/process components with states pending, active, failed, interrupted, completed and indeterminate. Failed cuts show failure or actual damage; unresolved mass change shows uncertainty. No dried/preserved/safe success badge, completed measurement animation or positive reward visual before the corresponding real event is committed.\"}]}"}
